title: Institute data sheet
intro: Everything the system needs to set up your institute and your website, in one place. Fill this in (or give the same facts to ChatGPT with the prompt file from Customize > Quick setup), get a .json file back and upload it. Pictures are not part of the file: the logo, the gallery and the photos of people are added on the Institute and Website tabs.
rules: Leave out anything you do not have. Whatever is missing stays as it is now.
Write plain sentences. Do not invent numbers, results, awards or names that are not true.
Keep to the limits shown. A longer text is shortened, and extra items are dropped.
Lists replace the list on the website. A trainer, partner or student whose name stays the same keeps the photo already added.

sections.title: 1. The institute
sections.note: Shown on the website, on every certificate, ID card and fee receipt, and in emails.

fields.label: Name
fields.what: The name of the institute, as it should be printed.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.what: One line that says what you do.
fields.example: Learn skills that get you hired.

fields.label: Main colour
fields.what: The colour of your brand as #rrggbb. Buttons, headers and cards use it.

fields.label: Email
fields.what: The address people write to.

fields.label: Phone
fields.what: The number people call. Printed on ID cards and receipts.

fields.label: Website address
fields.what: Your website, if it has another address.

fields.label: Full address
fields.what: The full postal address. Printed on ID cards, receipts and certificates, so write it once, correctly.
fields.example: Office 4, Sutra Plaza, FC Road, Pune 411004

fields.label: Signatory name
fields.what: The person who signs certificates.

fields.label: Signatory title
fields.what: Their post.

sections.title: 2. The top of the website
sections.note: The first thing a visitor reads.

fields.label: Small badge
fields.what: A short label above the heading, such as the admission status.

fields.label: Main heading
fields.what: The big heading.
fields.example: Learn skills that get you hired.

fields.label: Heading text
fields.what: Two lines under the heading.
fields.example: Live classes, hands-on projects, regular tests and a certificate you can prove.

fields.label: Figures
fields.what: Up to 4 true figures. Each has a value (up to 12 characters) and a label (up to 30). Leave out to show the automatic ones.

fields.label: Announcement bar
fields.what: A line across the top of every page. enabled is true or false; link is optional.

sections.title: 3. About, features and steps
sections.note: Who you are, why students choose you, and how it works.

fields.label: About, one line
fields.what: A sentence about the institute.
fields.example: A place to learn IT skills properly and get ready for work.

fields.label: About, points
fields.what: Up to 6 short points, each up to 160 characters.
example: Taught by working trainers, not just textbooks.
Classroom and online batches that fit your schedule.

fields.label: Why choose us
fields.what: Up to 9 items. Each has a title (up to 60) and a text (up to 200).

example.title: Live classes
example.text: Attend from anywhere and watch the recording if you miss one.

fields.label: How it works
fields.what: Up to 6 steps in order. Each has a title (up to 60) and a text (up to 200).

sections.title: 4. Trainers, partners and student feedback
sections.note: Only real people and real words. Photos are added later on the Website tab.

fields.label: Trainers
fields.what: Up to 12. Each has a name (up to 60) and what they teach (role, up to 80).

fields.label: Hiring partners
fields.what: Up to 18 companies that hire your students. Only companies that really do.

fields.label: Student feedback
fields.what: Up to 6. Each has the student's name (up to 60), what they do now (role, up to 80) and their words (text, up to 300). Only with the student's permission.

example.name: Asha Patil
example.text: The tests kept me on track.

fields.label: Questions and answers
fields.what: Up to 14. Each has a question q (up to 160) and an answer a (up to 600).

fields.label: Social links
fields.what: Any of whatsapp (number with country code, digits only), instagram, youtube, facebook, linkedin (full web addresses). Leave out what you do not have.

fields.label: WhatsApp button
fields.what: true shows a green WhatsApp button on the website (needs the WhatsApp number above).

fields.label: WhatsApp first message
fields.what: The message that is already typed when someone taps the button.
fields.example: Hello, I would like to know about your courses.

fields.label: Google Maps link
fields.what: The link from Google Maps, Share. A Google Maps address only.

sections.title: 6. What the website shows
sections.note: Choices about the course cards and the sections.

fields.label: Show the course fee
fields.what: true shows the fee on every course card of the website.

fields.label: Show the duration
fields.what: true shows the number of hours on every course card.

fields.label: Sections to hide
fields.what: Sections you do not want on the front page. Choose from: about, courses, why, how, gallery, faculty, partners, testimonials, faq, enquiry, contact.
